name: Matryoshka Doll: "Winter Snow, Spring Form"
description: A classic matryoshka doll with a timeless design. Its craftsmanship is particularly exquisite — a quality that Vodyanitsa is quite pleased with — making it an excellent piece for any collection.\nAlthough many new styles of matryoshka dolls have appeared on the market in Snezhnaya, classics endure forever.\n"Just like the songs of a certain Water Imp — they never go out of style."
